title: ExtremaLines mode params
description: Stitches per-row local extrema into vertical lines, then produces a detrended density signal and a detrended termination signal. Two ZProfiles are emitted and weighted independently.

blur_method.description: Blur method applied before extrema detection. 'none' skips blurring.

blur_kernel.description: Gaussian blur kernel size (must be odd). Only used when blur_method = 'gaussian'.

bilateral_d.description: Bilateral filter diameter. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_color.description: Bilateral filter sigma in color space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_space.description: Bilateral filter sigma in coordinate space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

use_ab.description: True = use A:B accumulated difference frames; False = single frame.

gradient_method.description: Optional Sobel gradient step applied after blur. 'none' = disabled (extrema detected on intensity). 'xy' = combined magnitude. 'x' = |Gx|. 'y' = |Gy|.

gradient_ksize.description: Sobel kernel size. Use 3, 5, or 7 (odd values only).

stitch_gap.description: Max column distance to stitch adjacent extrema points into one line (alias for max_gap).

max_gap.description: Max skipped rows allowed during forward stitching.

angle_tolerance.description: Max degrees from vertical allowed when extending a line. 90 = no angle constraint.

angle_mode.description: A = measure angle from line start; B = use recent-point running average.

angle_lock_points.description: Lock the angle measurement after this many points. 0 = recompute every point.

min_line_length.description: Minimum vertical span (rows) to keep a stitched line.

merge_angle_tol.description: Post-stitch merge: max endpoint angle difference (deg). 0 = disabled.

merge_row_sep.description: Post-stitch merge: max row gap between line endpoints to attempt merge.

merge_col_sep.description: Post-stitch merge: max column gap between line endpoints.

s5_vgap.description: Stage-5 endpoint merge: vertical gap tolerance (rows).

s5_hgap.description: Stage-5 endpoint merge: horizontal gap tolerance (cols).

s5_angle.description: Stage-5 endpoint merge: max endpoint angle difference (deg).

s5_pts.description: Stage-5 endpoint merge: number of points used for angle estimation.

term_window.description: ±rows to accumulate termination counts. 0 = exact row only.

detrend_method.description: Detrending method for both output signals.

detrend_degree.description: Polynomial degree — only used when detrend_method = 'polynomial'.

ignore_top_rows.description: Number of rows from the top of the ROI to force to zero in both output signals. These rows are excluded from POI detection and the graph shows 0 at these positions.

ignore_bottom_rows.description: Number of rows from the bottom of the ROI to force to zero in both output signals. These rows are excluded from POI detection and the graph shows 0 at these positions.

trough_threshold.description: Density signal: detrended residual must be below this value (negative). Deeper troughs = more confident candidate.

peak_threshold.description: Termination signal: detrended residual must be above this value.

min_distance.description: Minimum pixel distance between adjacent candidates.

use_contrast.description: When true, a per-pixel difference between the sample frame and a reference frame (e.g. tip without liquid) is computed before all other processing. The reference source is set in the A/B Compare dialog or via ImageSet.reference_frames. The contrast image replaces the normal working frame.

contrast_mode.description:
'absolute' — output = |sample − reference|. Values below contrast_min → 0; at or above contrast_max → 255; in between linearly scaled to 0–255.

'relative' — signed difference centred at grey (127). sample brighter → > 127; reference brighter → < 127. |diff| < contrast_min → 127 (neutral); |diff| ≥ contrast_max → 0 or 255.

contrast_blur_method.description: Blur applied independently to both sample and reference before computing the difference. Independent of any other blur step in the pipeline.

contrast_blur_kernel.description: Gaussian kernel size for the contrast pre-blur (must be odd). Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'gaussian'.

contrast_bilateral_d.description: Bilateral filter diameter for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_bilateral_sigma_color.description: Bilateral sigma colour for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_bilateral_sigma_space.description: Bilateral sigma space for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_min.description: Minimum contrast threshold (0–255). Differences smaller than this are suppressed: 0 in absolute mode, 127 (neutral grey) in relative mode. Filters noise and background flicker.

contrast_max.description: Maximum contrast cap (0–255). Differences at or above this are fully saturated. Values between contrast_min and contrast_max are linearly stretched to 0–255. Must be greater than contrast_min.
